row.evidence: Otter's pricing page lists "SSO, SCIM, Domain Capture" under Enterprise (Schedule a demo), with "SCIM user provisioning minimum 100-user license required".
row.notes: Unchanged from June (gated). Pro $8.33/u/mo annual ($16.99 monthly), Business $19.99/u/mo annual ($30 monthly); SAML SSO and SCIM (Directory Sync) are Enterprise only with a 100-user minimum. SCIM deprovisioning deactivates the user (conversations retained). Okta and Entra are configured as new custom/non-gallery apps; the 2020 OIN app is SAML only. Public API and webhooks are Enterprise only and do not manage users. Help-centre citations use the Zendesk JSON API because the article pages return 403 to scripts.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Activity logs in the admin UI.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: SSO and SCIM need a minimum 100-user license. Otter API & Webhooks included but no user-management endpoints.

auth.token_source: Manage Workspace > Settings > Directory Sync (via SCIM) > Configure (setup generates Tenant URL and Secret Token)

endpoints.notes: Endpoint paths are not documented; users and groups are synced.

operations.notes: Updates (profile, email, role) are documented without the HTTP verb; profile updates need a claimed domain. Removal deactivates rather than deletes.

deprovision.data_retained: Active user is deactivated in the workspace (pending invitations are revoked); deactivation stops sign-in but conversations stay in the workspace.

attributes.notes: Otter lists synced attributes in plain terms (email, first name, last name, department, user role, workspace role); SCIM attribute names other than emails and externalId are not given.

roles.how: Two IdP groups (Members, Admins) are assigned and mapped to the Otter workspace roles Member and Admin; unmapped users default to Member.

rate_limits.text: Otter polls provisioning events every 5 minutes and processes up to 100 events per workspace per cycle.

limitations.text: Requires the Enterprise plan with at least 100 seats, enabled by the account manager.
Okta: must create a new Okta application; using an existing application is not supported.
Profile attributes of existing users are only updated when the email domain is claimed (domain capture).

scim.notes: Tenant URL and secret token are generated in the Directory Sync setup flow; the base URL pattern is not published. SCIM attribute notation (emails[type eq "work"].value) implies SCIM 2.0 but the version is not stated.

capabilities.notes: False by absence: the documented endpoint lists contain no user-management operations.

endpoints.purpose: Workspace details incl. owner and member count (Super Admin only)

webhooks_user_events.notes: Workspace webhooks document a conversation_completed event; no user events found.

audit_log_api.notes: Activity logs are a Business-tier admin feature in the UI; no audit-log API is documented.

rate_limits.text: Enterprise plan users are limited to 10 requests/second; 429 when exceeded.

user_api.notes: Otter's Public API (Enterprise only) and Super Admin APIs cover conversations, transcripts, channels and workspace details; no endpoints to create, update or remove users are documented, so no user-management API.

okta.notes: OIN app (last updated May 2020) marks only SAML as checked (page markup). Otter's SCIM guide has admins create a new Okta application for Directory Sync.

entra.notes: No gallery app (learn.microsoft.com otter-ai-tutorial returns 404); Otter's SSO and SCIM guides use a non-gallery enterprise app with Tenant URL + Secret Token.
